entries.source: #rng# the Herald
entries.target: 传令官#rng#

entries.source: The fall of Zigur
entries.target: 伊格的陷落

entries.source: You decided to side with the Grand Corruptor and joined forces to assault the Ziguranth main base of power.
entries.target: 你决定站在大腐化者一边，与他联手进攻伊格兰斯的主要势力据点。

entries.source: The Grand Corruptor died during the attack before he had time to teach you his ways.
entries.target: 大腐化者还没来得及传授他的手段，便在进攻中战死了。

entries.source: The defenders of Zigur were crushed, the Ziguranth scattered and weakened.
entries.target: 伊格的守军被击溃，伊格兰斯四散而逃，元气大伤。

entries.source: In the aftermath you turned against the Grand Corruptor and dispatched him.
entries.target: 事后，你转而与大腐化者为敌，并杀死了他。

entries.source: Select the party member to receive the hexes generic talent tree:
entries.target: 选择接受邪术技能树的队伍成员：

entries.source: Grand Corruptor
entries.target: 大腐化者

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#The Grand Corruptor gazes upon you. You feel knowledge flowing in your mind. You can now train some corruption powers.
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#大腐化者凝视着你。你感觉到知识在你的脑海里流动。你可以学习一些堕落能力了。

entries.source: Victory is mine!
entries.target: 胜利是属于我的！

entries.source: While you were in the Far East, the Grand Corruptor was busy in Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 当你在远东战斗的时候，大腐化者正在马基·埃亚尔忙碌着。

entries.source: With the fall of Zigur he was able to attack and take control of Elvala, the Shaloren capital city.
entries.target: 在伊格陨落之后，他成功地进攻并占领了埃尔瓦拉，永恒精灵的首都。

entries.source: His plans however do not stop there.
entries.target: 他的野心绝不止步于此。

entries.source: The Curse of Magic
entries.target: 魔法的诅咒

entries.source: You have been invited to join a group called the Ziguranth, dedicated to opposing magic.
entries.target: 你被邀请参加一个叫做伊格兰斯的组织，致力于对抗魔法。

entries.source: Grim-looking fighter
entries.target: 面目狰狞的斗士

entries.source: #VIOLET#A foe is summoned to the arena!
entries.target: #VIOLET#一个对手被召唤进了竞技场！

entries.source: #VIOLET#Another foe is summoned to the arena!
entries.target: #VIOLET#又一个对手被召唤进了竞技场！

entries.source: The agent of the arena
entries.target: 竞技场代理人

entries.source: You were asked to prove your worth as a fighter by a rogue, in order to participate in the arena
entries.target: 一个盗贼要求你证明自己作为斗士的实力，以获得参加竞技场的资格。

entries.source: You succesfully defeated your adversaries and gained access to the arena!
entries.target: 你成功战胜了对手，现在可以进入竞技场了！

entries.source: The Arena
entries.target: 竞技场

entries.source: Seeking wealth, glory, and a great fight, you challenge the Arena!
entries.target: 寻找财富、荣耀和强大的对手，去挑战竞技场吧！

entries.source: Can you defeat your foes and become Master of Arena?
entries.target: 你能打败对手，成为竞技场主宰吗？

entries.source: Winner
entries.target: 游戏胜利

entries.source: #GOLD#Well done! You have won the Arena: Challenge of the Master#WHITE#
entries.target: #GOLD#干得好！你赢得了竞技场：擂主的挑战#WHITE#

entries.source: You valiantly fought every creature the arena could throw at you and you emerged victorious!
entries.target: 你勇敢地战胜了竞技场里的所有生物并赢得了最终胜利！

entries.source: Glory to you, you are now the new master and your future characters will challenge you.
entries.target: 荣耀属于你！你已成为新的竞技场主宰，未来的角色将向你发起挑战。

entries.source: The Brotherhood of Alchemists
entries.target: 炼金术士兄弟会

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Thanks to your timely aid, %s is the newest member of the Brotherhood of Alchemists.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#感谢你的及时帮助，%s成为了炼金术士兄弟会的新成员。#WHITE#

entries.source: #RED#You aided various denizens of Maj'Eyal in their attempts to join the Brotherhood of Alchemists, though you did not prove the deciding factor for any. This year's new member is %s.#WHITE#
entries.target: #RED#你帮助了马基·埃亚尔的许多人尝试加入炼金术士兄弟会，但你的帮助对其中任何一人都未起到决定作用。今年的新成员是%s。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#Various alchemists around Maj'Eyal are competing to gain entry into the great Brotherhood of Alchemists, and one or more have enlisted your aid.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#很多马基·埃亚尔的炼金术士想竞争加入强大的炼金术士兄弟会，其中有一个或者几个人请求你的帮助。#WHITE#

entries.source: #GREEN#You have aided %s in creating an %s.#WHITE#
entries.target: #GREEN#你帮助%s制造了%s。#WHITE#

entries.source: #RED#%s has completed an %s without your aid.#WHITE#
entries.target: #RED#%s已经制造了%s，并没有获得你的帮助。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#Having failed to gain admittance to the Brotherhood of the Alchemists, %s no longer needs your help making the %s.
entries.target: #SLATE#无法获得炼金术士兄弟会的承认，%s不再需要你帮忙制作 %s。

entries.source: %s needs your help making an %s. He has given you some notes on the ingredients:
entries.target: %s 需要你帮忙制作 %s。他给了你一张写着配方的小纸条：

entries.source: #SLATE#  * 'Needed: one %s. %s'#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#  * '需要：一个%s。%s'#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#  * You've found the needed %s.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN# * 你找到了所需要的%s。#WHITE#

entries.source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
entries.target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

entries.source: #VIOLET#You can check the ingredients you possess by pressing Escape and selecting 'Show ingredients'.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你现在可以按 Esc 键调出游戏菜单，选择“查看材料”检查自己所拥有的材料。

entries.source: You receive: %s
entries.target: 你收到：%s。

entries.source: elixir of the fox
entries.target: 狡诈药剂

entries.source: elixir of avoidance
entries.target: 闪避药剂

entries.source: elixir of precision
entries.target: 精准药剂

entries.source: elixir of mysticism
entries.target: 神秘药剂

entries.source: elixir of the savior
entries.target: 守护药剂

entries.source: elixir of mastery
entries.target: 掌握药剂

entries.source: elixir of explosive force
entries.target: 爆炸药剂

entries.source: elixir of serendipity
entries.target: 幸运药剂

entries.source: elixir of focus
entries.target: 专注药剂

entries.source: elixir of brawn
entries.target: 蛮牛药剂

entries.source: elixir of stoneskin
entries.target: 石肤药剂

entries.source: elixir of foundations
entries.target: 领悟药剂

entries.source: The Doom of the World!
entries.target: 世界末日！

entries.source: You were sent to the Charred Scar at the heart of which lies a huge volcano. In the Age of Pyre it destroyed the old Sher'Tul ruins that stood there, absorbing much of their latent magic.
entries.target: 你被送到了灼烧之痕，其中心是一座巨大的火山——烈火纪元时，喷发的火山摧毁了当时矗立于此的古老夏·图尔遗址，并吸收了其中潜藏的大量魔法。

entries.source: This place is still full of that power and the orcs intend to absorb this power using the Staff of Absorption!
entries.target: 这里仍然充满了那种能量，兽人打算用吸能法杖的力量来吸收这里的能量！

entries.source: Whatever their plan may be, they must be stopped at all cost.
entries.target: 不管他们有何图谋，必须不惜一切代价阻止他们。

entries.source: The volcano is attacked by orcs. A few Sun Paladins made it there with you. They will hold the line at the cost of their lives to buy you some time.
entries.target: 火山正遭到兽人的攻击。几名太阳骑士与你一同赶到了这里，他们将不惜牺牲生命坚守防线，为你争取一些时间。

entries.source: Honor their sacrifice; do not let the orcs finish their work!
entries.target: 向他们的献身精神致敬！不要让兽人们达成所愿！

entries.source: You arrived too late. The place has been drained of its power and the sorcerers have left.
entries.target: 你来得太晚了，这里的能量已经被吸干，而那些巫师已经离开了。

entries.source: Use the portal to go back to the Far East. You *MUST* stop them, no matter the cost.
entries.target: 使用传送门返回远东大陆，你*必须*阻止他们，不惜一切代价。

entries.source: You arrived in time and interrupted the ritual. The sorcerers have departed.
entries.target: 你及时赶到并打断了仪式，巫师们已经离去。

entries.source: #VIOLET#A portal activates in the distance. You hear the orcs shout, 'The Sorcerers have departed! Follow them!'
entries.target: #VIOLET#远处一个传送门被激活，你听到兽人们吼道：“巫师们已经离开！跟上他们！”

entries.source: #VIOLET#The Sorcerers flee through a portal. As you prepare to follow them, a huge faeros appears to block the way.
entries.target: #VIOLET#巫师们从传送门逃跑了，当你准备跟随他们时，一个巨大的法罗挡住了去路。

entries.source: From bellow, it devours
entries.target: 来自深渊，吞噬四方

entries.source: Your escape from Reknor got your heart pounding and your desire for wealth and power increased tenfold.
entries.target: 从瑞库纳逃出后，你的心脏狂跳不止，对财富和力量的渴望也增加了十倍。

entries.source: Maybe it is time for you to start an adventurer's career. Deep below the Iron Throne mountains lies the Deep Bellow.
entries.target: 也许是你开始冒险生涯的时候了，在钢铁王座山脉的深处有个叫深渊咆哮的地下城。

entries.source: It has been long sealed away but still, from time to time adventurers go there looking for wealth.
entries.target: 那里已被尘封许久，但仍不时有冒险者前去寻找财宝。

entries.source: None that you know of has come back yet, but you did survive Reknor. You are great.
entries.target: 据你所知，至今还没有人回来过，不过你毕竟从瑞库纳幸存了下来。你很了不起。

entries.source: The Island of Dread
entries.target: 恐怖之岛

entries.source: You have heard that near the Charred Scar, to the south, lies a ruined tower known as the Dreadfell.
entries.target: 你听说在灼烧之痕南部有一个叫做恐惧王座的荒塔废墟。

entries.source: There are disturbing rumors of greater undead, and nobody who reached it ever returned.
entries.target: 传说那里有强大的亡灵生物，凡是到达那里的人都有去无回。

entries.source: Perhaps you should explore it and find the truth, and the treasures, for yourself!
entries.target: 也许你应该去那里一探究竟，顺便可以找到埋藏在那里的财宝！
